name: cloud-operator-setup
description: Sets up the operator agent in a Google Cloud project via the autocloud MCP server: picks the operator project, creates or checks the user's operator agent, saves the project, and offers to share the user's existing Google Cloud operating context with the operator agent's memory. Use when the user runs this skill, asks to set up the operator or create their operator agent, or chooses setup when the cloud-operator skill asks. Don't use for ordinary GCP requests or installing gcloud.
